map.所见即所得（WYSIWYG）在线编辑器：支持加粗、斜体、下划线、标题层级、有序/: A WYSIWYG online editor: supports bold, italic, underline, heading levels, ordered/unordered lists, hyperlinks, tables, text and background colors, alignment, blockquotes, and code blocks; counts characters, words, and paragraphs in real time; exports HTML source, plain text, or Markdown with one click, and imports local HTML files to keep editing. Everything runs locally in the browser; content is never uploaded.

map.可以存，但必须在服务端做消毒（sanitize）：富文本的 HTML 来自不可信: Yes, but you must sanitize on the server: rich-text HTML comes from untrusted input, and rendering it directly opens XSS. Use a whitelist to keep only necessary tags and attributes (drop script, iframe, on* events, and style), and sanitize both before storage and before rendering—don't rely on front-end filtering alone.
